params.name: environment
params.description: The environment where the eNote, transaction, or audit log will be located.

items.docs: Creates a new <Glossary>eNote</Glossary> in eVault from the supplied borrower, property, and loan details along with the eNote document data (the eNote file and its PDF rendering).

params.name: enote_id
params.description: The unique identifier for an eNote

items.docs: Retrieves the full details and current status of an <Glossary>eNote</Glossary> by its guid, including its registration status, named parties, and <Glossary>audit log</Glossary> entries.
Retrieves the <Glossary>smartdoc</Glossary> (SMART Doc®) representation of an <Glossary>eNote</Glossary> by its guid.
Retrieves the PDF rendering of an <Glossary>eNote</Glossary> by its guid.

Retrieves the <Glossary>audit log</Glossary> for an <Glossary>eNote</Glossary> — the time-ordered record of events (registration, transfers, status changes, and so on) recorded against its <Glossary>electronic record</Glossary>.

info.name: Upload a document to an eNote

items.docs: Uploads one or more supporting documents (such as an appraisal or title policy) and attaches them to an <Glossary>eNote</Glossary>.
